verdict: Air Products' sales rose 12% to $3.56B and its core gases business grew strongly, but charges for exiting two China coal-gasification projects held reported operating income to $633M.

kpis.label: Adjusted EPS
kpis.note: Excluding the exit charges; beat guidance

kpis.label: Americas sales
kpis.note: Volumes up 26% on new plants starting up

segments.name: Americas
segments.note: The largest region; volumes jumped 26% as new on-site plants started up, plus an asset sale tied to an early contract termination.

segments.name: Europe
segments.note: Growth mostly reflects higher energy costs passed through to customers, plus 2% pricing.

segments.name: Corporate & other
segments.note: Includes equipment sales, which fell from a year ago.

opex.name: Selling & administrative
opex.note: Sales, admin and overhead for the global gases business.

opex.name: Business & asset actions
opex.note: Charges for exiting projects — primarily two coal-gasification plants in China. Shown net of $25M of other operating income.

otherDetail: Equity affiliates' income — profits from joint ventures, including a large affiliate in Saudi Arabia — added $189M; interest expense took back $67M, for net other income of $122M.

takeaways.title: Sales rose to $3.56B
takeaways.text: Americas led with 27% growth as new on-site plants started up; Asia grew 4% and Europe 8%.

takeaways.title: Exit charges cut reported profit
takeaways.text: Exiting two China coal-gasification plants cost $223M this quarter; excluding such items, operating income would have been $856M.

takeaways.title: Adjusted EPS beat guidance
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS of $3.61 topped the guidance midpoint, and fiscal 2027 guidance of $14.15–$14.50 implies another year of growth.

footerNote: Business and asset actions are shown net of $25M of other operating income that the company reports inside operating income. Consolidated net income of $556M is shown; net income attributable to Air Products was $584M because noncontrolling interests absorbed a $28M loss.
